Lint an R script or Quarto/RMarkdown document for statistical hazards

Source: R/lint-engine.R
stat_lint.Rd

Parses .R, .qmd, or .Rmd source code into an abstract syntax tree (AST) and evaluates registered statistical and methodological lint rules.

Usage

stat_lint(path, rules = NULL, exclude_rules = NULL, skip_eval_false = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Path to an .R, .r, .qmd, or .Rmd file.

rules

Optional subset of rules to run: a character vector of rule IDs, a list of statci_rule objects, or NULL (default) to run all registered rules.

exclude_rules

Optional character vector of rule IDs to skip.

skip_eval_false

Logical; for .qmd/.Rmd files, skip chunks with eval = FALSE or #| eval: false. Default FALSE.

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_lint" containing findings (a tibble::tibble), files, rules_run, summary, and status ("pass", "warn", or "fail").

Examples

res <- stat_lint_text("x <- rnorm(100)\n")
res
#> [FAIL] statci lint: 1 file(s), 20 rule(s) | 1 error(s), 0 warning(s), 0 info
#> ERROR <text:r>:1:6 (unseeded_randomness): Stochastic call `rnorm()` invoked
#> without a preceding `set.seed()` or `withr::with_seed()` call.
